interpretation.target_reader: An adult comparing lip flip and lip filler near Olney, MD, seeking a modest or fuller result and clarity about the relevant tradeoffs.

The practice offers a Botox lip flip and identifies lip-specific filler among its wider filler range.
The gallery includes a 0.5 mL example, supporting discussion of a modest filler change.
